item.tib: dgongs 'dus bla sgrub skor gsum las/ bla ma yid bzhin nor bu'i mchog sgrub tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i rol pa
item.coloph: bdag 'dra rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis rgyal thang lha bkra shis yongs rdzong gi shar phyogs rtse bkra shis bya skyibs 'od gsal phug nas rje rig 'dzin kun grol grags pa lnga pa gtsos 'dus pa skal ldan sum cu bskal (lhag)tsam gyis dbang po'i spyod yul dngos su mthong ba rgya rim pa gsum bkrol der spyan drangs pa'i shog ser las/ las can gyi dang po dge rigs tshe dbang bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas dang rigs dang po'i me tog gi mtshams sbyar nas nan cher bskul ba'i tshe mang ri bkra shis mthong smon dga' ldan khyab bdal g.yung drung gling mdo sngags rgyud sde'i gzhal med khang bzang po'i gzims skyil byang chub bde gsal khang du dag par phab ste/ man ngag dang las byang khrigs su bsdebs te spel bas dge des rgyal bstan spyi dang g.yung drung bon gyi bstan 'dzin mchog rnams rgyu 'bras tshogs gnyis sprin gyi mdzod chen po la longs su spyod pa'i skal can du gyur cig/
